cards.card_text: True or false: King Artaxerxes also says mighty kings once ruled over Jerusalem and were paid tribute.

cards.snippet: …and exercised authority over the whole region west of the Euphrates; and tribute, duty, and toll were paid to them.

cards.card_text: Under the king's letter, the priests, Levites and other servants of God's house can't be charged tribute or tolls.
cards.verse_text: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.
